mapper.sql: s.id, s.script_code AS scriptCode, s.script_name AS scriptName, s.enabled, s.description, s.updated_at AS updatedAt, s.current_revision_no AS revisionNo, r.script_version AS scriptVersion, r.script_language AS scriptLanguage, r.runtime_version AS runtimeVersion

, s.current_revision_id AS currentRevisionId, r.source_type AS sourceType, r.source_path AS sourcePath, r.source_content AS sourceContent, r.entry_point AS entryPoint, CAST(r.arguments_json AS CHAR) AS argumentsJson

where.if: AND (s.script_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.script_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM dpm_test_script s LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script_revision r ON r.id = s.current_revision_id
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_test_script s LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script_revision r ON r.id = s.current_revision_id
SELECT FROM dpm_test_script s LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script_revision r ON r.id = s.current_revision_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT id, enabled, current_revision_no AS revisionNo FROM dpm_test_script WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dpm_test_script s LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script_revision r ON r.id = s.current_revision_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.enabled = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dpm_test_script (script_code, script_name, script_language, runtime_version, source_type, source_path, source_content, entry_point, arguments_json, enabled, description, current_revision_no, created_by) VALUES (#{scriptCode}, #{scriptName}, #{scriptLanguage}, #{runtimeVersion}, #{sourceType}, #{sourcePath}, #{sourceContent}, #{entryPoint},
CAST(#{argumentsJson} AS JSON) NULL , #{enabled}, #{description}, 0, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE dpm_test_script SET script_code = #{request.scriptCode}, script_name = #{request.scriptName}, script_language = #{request.scriptLanguage}, runtime_version = #{request.runtimeVersion}, source_type = #{request.sourceType}, source_path = #{request.sourcePath}, source_content = #{request.sourceContent}, entry_point = #{request.entryPoint}, arguments_json = CAST(#{request.argumentsJson} AS JSON) NULL , enabled = #{request.enabled}, description = #{request.description}, current_revision_no = #{revisionNo} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dpm_test_script_revision (script_id, revision_no, script_version, script_language, runtime_version, source_type, source_path, source_content, entry_point, arguments_json, change_note, created_by) VALUES (#{scriptId}, #{revisionNo}, #{scriptVersion}, #{scriptLanguage}, #{runtimeVersion}, #{sourceType}, #{sourcePath}, #{sourceContent}, #{entryPoint},
CAST(#{argumentsJson} AS JSON) NULL , #{changeNote}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE dpm_test_script SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, script_id, revision_no, script_version, script_language, runtime_version, source_type, source_path, source_content, entry_point, CAST(arguments_json AS CHAR) AS arguments_json, change_note, created_by, created_at FROM dpm_test_script_revision WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} ORDER BY revision_no DESC

SELECT id, script_id, revision_no, script_version, script_language, runtime_version, source_type, source_path, source_content, entry_point, CAST(arguments_json AS CHAR) AS arguments_json, change_note, created_by, created_at FROM dpm_test_script_revision WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} AND id = #{revisionId}
